# trs — Token-Reducing Shell

> trs is a transparent CLI proxy that compresses terminal output for AI coding agents.
> It sits between the agent and the shell: the agent runs `git status`, trs intercepts it,
> spawns the real command, and returns a compact summary instead of raw output —
> typically 60–99% fewer tokens with no loss of actionable signal.
> Works with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Kilo Code, OpenCode, Codex CLI, Windsurf, and more.
> Single native binary (~6 MB), zero runtime deps, ~12 ms startup, Rust-powered.

## Getting started

- [Install trs](https://usetrs.dev/support/install.md): curl|sh, PowerShell, npm, cargo, or prebuilt binary
- [Wire up your agent](https://usetrs.dev/features/init.md): `trs init` — one command to install the hook for any supported agent
- [Output saver](https://usetrs.dev/features/output-saver.md): installs anti-preamble / result-first rules into each agent's global config

## Supported agents

- [Agent compatibility matrix](https://usetrs.dev/support/agents.md): Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Kilo Code, Factory Droid, Codex CLI, Windsurf, Google Antigravity

## Supported commands

- [Full command reference](https://usetrs.dev/support/commands.md): git, cargo, npm/pnpm/bun/yarn, Python tools, curl, docker, gh CLI, and more

## Features

- [trs init](https://usetrs.dev/features/init.md): agent hook installer with collision detection, `--global` and `--project` scopes
- [trs stats](https://usetrs.dev/features/stats.md): token savings analytics, per-command and per-agent breakdowns
- [trs ingest](https://usetrs.dev/features/ingest.md): compress local files or URLs before reading them into context
- [trs output-saver](https://usetrs.dev/features/output-saver.md): installs Markdown rules blocks that keep agent replies concise
- [trs doctor](https://usetrs.dev/features/doctor.md): diagnose hook and PATH issues
- [trs upgrade](https://usetrs.dev/features/upgrade.md): self-update the binary in place
- [trs audit-docs](https://usetrs.dev/features/audit-docs.md): scan documentation files for bloat and redundancy

## Safety and configuration

- [Safety guarantees](https://usetrs.dev/support/safety.md): credential preservation scan, fail-open on errors, 10% ratio gate
- [Configuration](https://usetrs.dev/features/configuration.md): TRS_SKIP, TRS_DEBUG, per-command passthrough options
- [Output formats](https://usetrs.dev/features/formats.md): plain text, JSON, structured compression rules
